summary.intent: Add an average() helper returning the mean cart price for the new summary panel, which must cope with empty carts (PR title/body; commit 609ed60).
summary.issue_fit: Partial - the mean is computed, but the stated empty-cart case is not handled. No originating issue was available; the intent source is the caller-supplied PR text and the single commit message.
summary.coverage: Complete merge-base diff (main...review-head, one commit, pricing.py) reviewed; no callers exist in the repository and no tests were added. Reviewer-executed reproduction of average([]) at the head raised ZeroDivisionError. Base resolved from the caller's explicit local ref main; uncommitted changes: none.

findings.title: Handle empty carts in average()
findings.trigger: average() is called with an empty list, e.g. a newly created cart.
findings.impact: average([]) raises an unhandled ZeroDivisionError, so the summary panel fails for every new cart, contrary to the PR's stated empty-cart case (the panel itself is not in this repository).
findings.change: In `pricing.py`, return 0.0 (or raise a documented ValueError that callers handle) when `prices` is empty; add a test for the empty list.
findings.source: PR body: "Carts can be empty right after creation."
